name: LITTLEBIT
description: D/A converter using bit stream 7350 chip.The input format is the SONY/Philips Biphase Format (SPDIF) Standard and uses a 7350 bit stream chip.Fully differential balanced mode with a sampling rate of 384 x.The digital filter uses 8 x oversampling of 18 bits.Dark green aluminum die-cast case is used for the case.The power supply is equipped with separate regulators for digital and analog power.Gold-plated terminals are used for input / output terminals.

name: PDM-1-2
description: "D/A converter announced as an upgraded model of PDM-1.The input format is SONY/Philips Biphase Format TYPE1 Standard.The chip is a bit stream type 7350 chip.Fully differential balanced mode with a sampling rate of 384 x.The digital filter uses an 8-times oversampling 18-bit filter.For the analog circuit, OH-OA32 which is Hybrid OP-Amp of Dell Tech is adopted.There is an LED indicator on the front panel that shows power on/off and digital lock.The power supply consists of two power supplies with independent regulators for digital and analog power supplies.Dark green aluminum die-cast case is used for the case.Gold-plated terminals are used for input / output terminals."
